ten_viet: Chùng chân lùi luân phiên với đòn
steps: Stand tall with the barbell resting on your upper back and hands holding it firmly. | Step one foot back and lower your back knee towards the floor with control. | Keep your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes. | Push through your front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.
setup: Set the bar on a rack at chest height and unrack it with both feet under the bar. | Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders, wrists straight, elbows pointing down. | Leave enough space behind you to step back safely; use the rack safety pins. | Start with an empty bar until the movement feels steady.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Set the rope attachment at about face height and hold one end in each hand. | Step back until your arms are straight and stand tall with a steady torso. | Pull the rope towards your face, keeping your elbows high and apart. | Pause briefly, then return slowly without leaning back.
setup: Set the cable pulley at face height and use the rope attachment. | Hold the rope with thumbs pointing back towards you. | Pull the rope ends apart beside your ears; keep your ribs down. | Choose a light weight: you should control the return without being pulled forward.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Set the bar in a rack with safety supports at a suitable height. | Rest the bar on your upper back, brace your torso and step back carefully. | Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat to a controlled depth. | Drive through your feet to stand up without rounding your back.
setup: Set the bar in the rack at mid-chest height and the safety pins just below your lowest squat depth. | Grip the bar evenly, hands just outside your shoulders, wrists straight; rest it on your upper back, not your neck. | Step back only two or three small steps and set your feet shoulder-width apart. | Ask for a spotter or use safety pins; start with the empty bar.
mistakes: Rushing the movement or holding your breath. | Using a range or load that causes pain.

steps: Sit at the machine and adjust the thigh pads so your legs are held firmly. | Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders with palms facing forward. | Lean back slightly, then pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back. | Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight, keeping control.
setup: Adjust the thigh pad so you cannot lift off the seat. | Use a grip just wider than shoulders; thumbs around the bar. | Pull to the top of your chest, never behind the neck. | Pick a weight you can pull without swinging your body.
mistakes: Leaning far back and swinging the body. | Pulling the bar behind the neck.

steps: Sit on the bench with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent. | Hold the handle with arms straight and back tall. | Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Return slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your back.
setup: Use the V-handle with palms facing each other. | Keep your chest up; do not lean back more than a little. | Pull elbows close to your sides toward your hips.
mistakes: Rounding the back to reach forward. | Jerking the weight with the body.

steps: Set the cable high and hold the bar or rope with elbows close to your sides. | Stand tall with a slight forward lean and stomach tight. | Push down until your arms are straight, moving only your forearms. | Let your hands rise slowly to about chest height.
setup: Pin your elbows to your sides; only the forearms move. | With a rope, spread the ends apart at the bottom. | Choose a weight you can control without leaning over it.
mistakes: Letting elbows move forward and back. | Leaning over the weight.

steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and sit with your back on the pad. | Hold the handles with a slight bend in your elbows. | Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a hugging motion. | Open your arms slowly until you feel a light stretch in the chest.
setup: Set the seat so your elbows are level with your shoulders. | Keep shoulders down and back against the pad. | Stop opening when you feel a gentle stretch, not pain in the shoulder.
mistakes: Letting the arms go too far back. | Shrugging the shoulders.

steps: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest. | Sit with your back flat on the pad and feet on the floor. | Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight. | Bring the handles back slowly to chest level.
setup: Set the seat so handles are at mid-chest, not at the neck. | Grip with wrists straight and elbows slightly below shoulder height. | Breathe out as you press, in as you return.
mistakes: Locking the elbows hard. | Lifting the back off the pad.

steps: Sit with your back flat on the pad and place your feet hip-width apart in the middle of the platform. | Release the safety handles and hold the side grips. | Bend your knees to lower the platform slowly, keeping your lower back on the pad. | Press the platform away through your whole foot without locking your knees.
setup: Feet flat, hip-width, in the middle of the platform. | Lower only as far as your lower back stays on the pad. | Lock the safety handles before getting out.
mistakes: Letting the lower back round off the seat at the bottom. | Locking the knees at the top.

steps: Adjust the back pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point. | Place the lower pad on the front of your shins, just above the ankles. | Straighten your legs to lift the pad and pause briefly. | Lower slowly back to the start.
setup: Line up your knee with the red pivot dot on the machine. | Hold the side handles to keep your hips on the seat. | Use a light weight and move slowly; stop if the knee hurts.
mistakes: Kicking the weight up fast. | Lifting the hips off the seat.

ten_viet: Cuốn đùi sau máy tư thế ngồi
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine pivot and lower the thigh pad onto your thighs. | Place the lower pad behind your legs, just above your heels. | Curl your heels down and under the seat while keeping your back on the pad. | Let your legs return slowly until they are almost straight.
setup: Line up your knees with the pivot point of the machine. | Lower the thigh pad until it holds your legs firmly. | Hold the handles and move slowly in both directions.
mistakes: Letting the weight pull your legs up quickly. | Lifting the hips or leaning back to move the weight.
review_note: ID cũ ghi lying nhưng tên bài hiện tại là Seated leg curl. Quay tư thế NGỒI; bài tư thế NẰM có ID gym-lying-leg-curl-machine riêng.

equipment: Đòn và bánh tạ, Ghế/bục chắc chắn
steps: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor. | Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it off the rack with straight arms. | Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest, elbows about 45 degrees from your body. | Press the bar back up over your shoulders and rack it safely.
setup: Set safety arms just below chest height or ask for a spotter. | Squeeze shoulder blades together and keep feet flat. | Wrists straight over elbows; start with the empty bar.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest. | Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.

steps: Stand with feet hip-width and the bar over the middle of your feet. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs. | Brace your stomach, keep your back flat and stand up by pushing the floor away, bar close to your legs. | Lower the bar by pushing your hips back, keeping it close, until it touches the floor.
setup: Learn the hip hinge first; start with a light bar or plates on blocks. | Keep the bar touching your legs the whole time. | Never round your back to reach the bar.
mistakes: Rounding the back. | Letting the bar drift away from the legs.

steps: Stand tall holding the bar at your thighs with hands shoulder-width apart. | Soften your knees and keep your back straight. | Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs until you feel a stretch in the back of your thighs. | Squeeze your glutes and bring your hips forward to stand tall.
setup: Start from standing (take the bar from a rack). | Keep the bar close to your legs. | Go down only as far as your back stays flat.
mistakes: Bending the knees too much like a squat. | Rounding the back to go lower.

steps: Hold the bar with hands just wider than shoulders and stand tall. | Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back and soft knees. | Pull the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades. | Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
setup: Grip just wider than shoulders, palms facing you. | Keep your torso still; only the arms move. | Use a light weight first to learn the position.
mistakes: Standing up during each rep. | Rounding the lower back.

steps: Set both pulleys high and hold one handle in each hand. | Step forward with one foot for balance, leaning slightly forward. | With a slight bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest. | Return slowly until you feel a light stretch in the chest.
setup: Stand in the middle of the station with a split stance. | Keep the elbow bend the same throughout. | Use a light weight; the movement should feel smooth.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a press. | Using too much weight and losing balance.

steps: Set the leg pads wide enough to feel a gentle stretch, then sit with your back against the pad. | Place the inside of your knees against the pads and hold the handles. | Squeeze your legs together in a smooth arc until the pads nearly touch. | Open your legs slowly back to the start without letting the weights touch.
setup: Start with a small range; widen it only if your hips feel comfortable. | Keep your back against the pad the whole time.
mistakes: Letting the weight slam the legs open. | Leaning forward and rocking the body.

steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your shoulders. | Sit with your back flat on the pad and grip the handles. | Press the handles straight up until your arms are almost straight. | Lower slowly back to shoulder level and repeat.
setup: Keep your feet flat and your ribs down so your back stays on the pad. | Stop just before your elbows lock.
mistakes: Arching the lower back away from the pad. | Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.

ten_viet: Kéo xà bằng máy trợ lực
steps: Choose an assistance weight; a heavier setting gives more help. | Step onto the platform, grip the handles slightly wider than your shoulders and kneel on the pad. | Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down. | Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight, then repeat.
setup: Start with plenty of assistance and reduce it over the weeks. | Keep your shoulders away from your ears as you pull.
mistakes: Swinging or kicking to get up. | Dropping down too fast.

ten_viet: Cuốn đùi sau máy tư thế nằm
steps: Lie face down with your knees just past the edge of the bench and the pad just above your heels. | Hold the handles and press your hips into the bench. | Curl your heels toward your hips as far as is comfortable. | Lower the pad slowly until your legs are almost straight.
setup: Keep your hips down on the bench. | Use a weight you can lower slowly.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the bench. | Letting the weight drop on the way down.

steps: Set the safety stops just below your lowest squat position. | Step under the bar, rest it on your upper back and place your feet slightly in front of you, shoulder-width apart. | Twist the bar to unhook it, then bend your knees and hips to sit down slowly. | Push through your whole foot to stand up, then twist the bar back onto the hooks when finished.
setup: Always set the safety stops first. | Go only as low as you can keep your back straight.
mistakes: Feet too far back so the knees hurt. | Forgetting to set the safety stops.

steps: Stand on the platform with your back and shoulders against the pads, feet shoulder-width apart. | Release the safety handles. | Bend your knees and lower slowly while keeping your heels down. | Press back up through your whole foot and lock the safety handles when done.
setup: Start light; this machine is harder than the leg press. | Keep your knees in line with your toes.
mistakes: Heels lifting off the platform. | Bouncing at the bottom.

ten_viet: Nhón gót máy tư thế ngồi
steps: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pads resting on your lower thighs. | Release the safety lever. | Raise your heels as high as you can and pause briefly. | Lower your heels slowly below the platform for a gentle stretch, then repeat.
setup: Move slowly and pause at the top. | Push through the big toe side of your foot.
mistakes: Bouncing quickly through short reps. | Rolling onto the outside of the feet.

steps: Attach a straight bar or handle to the low pulley and stand facing the machine. | Hold the bar with palms up, arms straight and elbows close to your sides. | Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without moving your elbows. | Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
setup: Stand tall and keep your elbows still. | Use a weight you can control on the way down.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight. | Elbows drifting forward.

ten_viet: Hip thrust – nâng hông tựa ghế
equipment: Đòn và bánh tạ, Ghế/bục chắc chắn
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded bar over your hips. | Place your feet flat, about hip-width apart, so your shins are vertical at the top. | Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees. | Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.
setup: Use a bar pad for comfort. | Keep your chin tucked and ribs down at the top.
mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top. | Feet too close or too far.

steps: Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders with palms facing away. | Hang with straight arms and pull your shoulders down. | Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down. | Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
setup: Use the assisted machine first if you cannot do 5 good reps. | Keep your body still; no swinging.
mistakes: Kicking or swinging. | Doing half reps without lowering fully.

steps: Stand tall holding the bar with palms facing up, hands shoulder-width apart. | Keep your elbows close to your sides. | Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without moving your elbows. | Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
setup: An EZ bar is easier on the wrists. | Keep your body still; no swinging.
mistakes: Leaning back to swing the bar. | Letting the bar drop quickly.
